title: CmdPal: Shelf (2/n) - Add recent commands to Home and quick access shelf
summary: The pinned upstream head was mirrored to an exact stacked-base fork PR and reviewed through three Copilot rounds. Four correctness fixes are committed on the fork and targeted builds pass, but the deadline arrived with a newer Copilot round exposing two additional valid shelf issues and three unresolved fork threads, so no upstream review is ready.

status.label: Review checkpointed — convergence incomplete
status.detail: Fork fixes address pinned ownership, stable Alt shortcuts, invalid placement values, and recent-command host context. A later review found that hidden-over-limit pins can still leak into Recent and that the shortcut help text no longer matches the stable-pinned scheme; one repeated host-context comment is already addressed. Deadline reached before another fix/review cycle.

next_action.label: Resume fork review loop
next_action.reason: Fix pinned-key reservation beyond the display limit and update the shortcut description, reply/resolve the three current Copilot threads, rebuild/retest, and request a fresh zero-comment review before drafting any upstream action.

judgment.rationale: The review is not converged: the latest completed Copilot pass is against fork commit bb74665c9, three threads remain unresolved, and two newly identified issues still require code changes. The upstream head remains pinned and unchanged, so the fork state is safely resumable.
evidence: Upstream head remains 0f584eec26d12fab32ed3aa70b8d7c4c8e4f5ae2 and the fork PR uses the exact stacked base e501b730fe3a662a7082de95ecb4055bfe59ec77 with the same 26-file scope.
Fork commits bb74665c9, 1d4ef8726, and 1f9e891d7 preserve pinned ownership/shortcuts, unwrap recent command host context, normalize persisted placement enums, and correct regression expectations.

CmdPal UI and Microsoft.CmdPal.UI.ViewModels.UnitTests projects build successfully after restore. The broad targeted run passed 63/64 tests before the corrected expectation was rebuilt; the resolver subset then passed 10/10.

The latest Copilot pass left three threads: host-context handling is already fixed by 1d4ef8726; pinned commands beyond the display limit still need to reserve ownership; localized shortcut help must describe stable pinned ordering.
Upstream CLA, intake, dependency review, telemetry detection, and affected-test resolution checks pass; x64 and arm64 release builds were still running at the final freshness check.
judgment.recommended_action: Resume the saved fork loop; do not post an upstream review until the two outstanding findings are fixed and a fresh review returns zero comments.
